reason: This rule aligns with the contradiction pattern where a factual statement about the nonexistence of heart attacks before 1920 is contradicted by the factual occurrence of heart attacks in that time period. The conclusion that heart attacks are nonexistent is logically consistent with the premise that they did not occur.
refined_position: Temporal contradiction regarding the factual occurrence of heart attacks before 1920
reflecting_rules: - 1. Q[year, status](Heart_Attacks.time_period = before_1920 ∧ Heart_Attacks.occurrence(year) = false → Heart_Attacks.status = nonexistent)
